# PLAN — iteration 2

## Current state assessment

Iteration 1 is the verified best: it passed the fixed testbench and timing gates, and reduced routed LUTs from 328 to 20 using four DSP48 multipliers. Timing is feasible at WNS 0.105 ns and WHS 0.18 ns, so iteration 2 must strictly reduce LUTs to improve the `minimize_luts` objective; adding another DSP is acceptable if the LUT count falls and all gates still pass.

## Hypothesis

Mapping the pair-sum and final-sum adders into DSP48 resources may reduce LUT use while retaining the existing two-stage, minimum-age-2 behavior.

## Instruction for generator

Keep the four 16-bit products, both 17-bit stage-1 partial sums, and the existing elastic valid/ready state unchanged. Apply Vivado `USE_DSP = "yes"` to the explicitly widened pair-sum additions and the 18-bit final addition captured into `stage2_data`, preserving all carry bits and the current register boundaries. Keep the top declaration `// @latency 2`; retain this candidate only if the unchanged integration testbench passes and routed timing remains feasible, with a strict LUT reduction over the 20-LUT incumbent.
